jobs.job_statement: When I need to purchase fashion items quickly, I want reliable delivery and an easy return/refund process, so I can feel confident that I’ll receive what I ordered and can get my money back if it doesn’t fit.
jobs.current_solution: Users resort to alternative platforms (Myntra, original brand sites), rely on COD orders, or repeatedly contact customer support.

opportunities.title: End‑to‑End Delivery & Return Revamp
opportunities.description: Introduce guaranteed delivery windows, proactive shipment tracking, and an automated, self‑service return/refund portal to eliminate manual bottlenecks.
opportunities.recommended_experiment: Pilot a “fast‑track” delivery & instant‑refund flow for a 10% user cohort; measure NPS, repeat purchase rate, and churn vs control.
opportunities.core_value_prop: Pilot a “fast‑track” delivery & instant‑refund flow for a 10% user cohort; measure NPS, repeat purchase rate, and churn vs control.

opportunities.title: Customer Service Modernization
opportunities.description: Deploy a mixed‑model support system (AI‑driven triage + live agents) with SLA dashboards visible to users, plus a post‑interaction feedback loop.
opportunities.recommended_experiment: A/B test a new in‑app chat widget with guaranteed 2‑hour response time against the existing ticket system; track resolution time and satisfaction scores.
opportunities.core_value_prop: A/B test a new in‑app chat widget with guaranteed 2‑hour response time against the existing ticket system; track resolution time and satisfaction scores.

opportunities.title: App Checkout UX Clean‑up
opportunities.description: Fix disappearing wallet top‑up UI, allow multiple voucher stacking where business rules permit, and streamline payment flow to reduce friction.
opportunities.recommended_experiment: Release a beta version of the checkout with persistent wallet option and multi‑voucher support to 5% of users; monitor cart abandonment and conversion lift.
opportunities.core_value_prop: Release a beta version of the checkout with persistent wallet option and multi‑voucher support to 5% of users; monitor cart abandonment and conversion lift.

opportunities.title: Transparent Pricing Initiative
opportunities.description: Show price‑match guarantees, highlight savings vs brand sites, and surface any additional fees up‑front to rebuild price trust.
opportunities.recommended_experiment: Add a price‑comparison badge on product pages for a subset of SKUs; track click‑through to competitor sites and conversion impact.
opportunities.core_value_prop: Add a price‑comparison badge on product pages for a subset of SKUs; track click‑through to competitor sites and conversion impact.

hypotheses.statement: Delivery delays are the primary driver of negative sentiment and user churn.

hypotheses.statement: The return and refund workflow is perceived as opaque and punitive, leading to frustration and loss of trust.
hypotheses.rationale: Comments such as "Can't even return now", "Worst. They will make your life hell if you dare to return the product", and "still it not returned...poor customer service".

hypotheses.statement: Customer service responsiveness is insufficient, causing users to feel abandoned and to switch to competitor platforms.
hypotheses.rationale: Reviews mention unhelpful support, rude agents, and no action taken after contacting care (e.g., "they were really rude" and "I even connected with customer support still no such action taken").

hypotheses.statement: Perceived price advantage of the Nykaa app is eroded by hidden costs or higher prices compared to the original brand site, prompting users to seek cheaper alternatives.
hypotheses.rationale: Comments like "Buy from the original site it is much more cheaper" and repeated mentions of price dissatisfaction.

hypotheses.statement: Technical glitches in the app (e.g., disappearing wallet top‑up option, voucher limitations) create transaction friction, leading to abandoned purchases and negative reviews.
